notes.title: Change in Branding/Update
notes.content:
The next update is finally almost here. With the addition of a create mode, functionality of Station Generator will be doubled. In the new mode you'll be able to edit stations you've generated to get them just right, or create your own station from scratch. More on that closer to launch.

Given the new functionality, and the ethos of the generator changing I will be changing the name of the app from Station Generator, to Station Architect. It makes more sense and it's a lot snappier! The change will happen with the update. 

Another change, which is happening now is a move from SeveralBytes as my studio name to Wyvern Industries which I think suits me a lot better. 

Thanks for reading!
AL Wyvern

notes.title: Update 1.5 Progress
notes.content:
Just a quick little notice to let you know I'm still working away at the new update, here's what I've got going so far:
[list]
[*]Drag and drop rooms
[*]Drag and drop corridors
[*]Drag and drop walls
[*]Drag and drop clear and empty
[*]Save/load functionality
[*]Re-introduce quality of life functionality
[*]Import stations from generate mode
[*]Clear canvas button
[*]Added feedback form to build mode
[*]Switch between modes
[*]Fix room/corridor clicking bug
[*]Auto generate corridors
[*]Add juice to generator menus
[*]Corridor gen takes corridor rooms into account
[*]Link to build in the main menu
[*]Zoom edge issues resolved
[*]Rooms can now be rotated
[/list]
As you can see plenty of work done so far which I'm pretty happy with. I'll also be rebranding Station Generator as Station Archtect with the new update since it changes the whole ethos of the app. I'll also be upping the price to ten dollars but that won't affect anyone who already has the app as the update itself will of course be free to all current owners :)

The good news is there's light at the end of the tunnel as there's no more on the done list than the todo list!

That's it for now, I hope you're all having good adventures, I'll drop more news as I have it.

notes.title: Build Mode Progress
notes.content:
Hey there folks, while I don't have a date for release yet, I thought you might be interested in hearing how the new build mode is progressing! These are the features I've implemented so far, in no particular order:
[list]
[*] Import a generated station for editing
[*] Change the size of the canvas
[*] Drag and drop rooms into the canvas
[*] Drag and drop corridors into the canvas
[*] Dropping a corridor onto a room will add the appropriate walls/doors configuration
[*] Added a satisfying (I think) click sound for when rooms and corridors are dropped
[*] Reintegrated the navigation, basic control and menu ribbons
[*] Added music and sfx
[*] Added the ability to save stations for editing later
[/list]

Things are going well and really there's not a huge amount more to add before it's feature complete. However it is still as ugly as sin so I have a lot of work to do in the UI department (no surprises there) so that's gonna take a while to tweak and get right. With so much going on it's important that this is as intuitive as possible right out of the box.

That's about all I have for now, and I'm pretty happy with how it's going so far!
